commands.cmd: p=$(command -v syft) && echo "resolves: $p -> $(readlink -f "$p")" && python3 -c "import json,glob,sys;c=sys.argv[1];print('stack',[x['version'] for x in json.load(open('manifests/stack.json'))['components'] if x['id']==c],'winner pins',sorted({w['pin'] for f in glob.glob('catalogs/landscape/*.json') for l in json.load(open(f)).get('layers',[]) for w in (l.get('winners') or []) if w.get('component_id')==c}))" syft

T="$HOME/.local/share/codex-ecosystem/tools/syft-1.52.0"; (cd "$T/downloads" && sha256sum --check --ignore-missing syft_1.52.0_checksums.txt) && u=$(python3 -c "import json;u=json.load(open('blueprints/us-equities/supply-chain/receipt.json'))['upstream'];print(u['archive_sha256'],u['publisher_checksum_list_sha256'],u['installed_binary_sha256'])") && a=$(sha256sum < "$T/downloads/syft_1.52.0_linux_amd64.tar.gz" | cut -c1-64) && c=$(sha256sum < "$T/downloads/syft_1.52.0_checksums.txt" | cut -c1-64) && m=$(tar -xzOf "$T/downloads/syft_1.52.0_linux_amd64.tar.gz" syft | sha256sum | cut -c1-64) && i=$(sha256sum < "$T/payload/syft" | cut -c1-64) && echo "archive $(echo $a | cut -c1-16)... | checksum list $(echo $c | cut -c1-16)... | member $(echo $m | cut -c1-16)... | installed $(echo $i | cut -c1-16)..." && test "$u" = "$a $c $i" && test "$m" = "$i" && echo "archive, publisher checksum list and installed binary all equal blueprints/us-equities/supply-chain/receipt.json upstream hashes"
